note: Ship drops of the regular maps, keyed by map id, variant key and node label. Drops and enemy fleets observed by TsunDB contributors, queried through KCNav (tsunkit.net/nav) and summed per node. Weights are observation counts. Drops seen fewer than 1 times and fleets met fewer than 1 times are left out. Generated by `kcnav normalize`; do not edit. An              entry with ship_id 0 is the outcome "nothing drops"; ranks lists the win ranks an              outcome was seen at. Entries listed in map_limited_drops.json are tagged limited and never drop.
